exact_statement: For the sign majority-three gate under every independent interior Bernoulli product law, natural corrected entropy E=(ln2)Hplus satisfies E <= (4+ln4)(I-Var) - (ln4-1)P({1,2,3}). Its exact all-bias supremum Hplus/(I-Var) is 2+4/ln2, not attained in the interior, and approached at probabilities (1-t^3,t,t). The result is invariant under input permutations/reflections with reflected biases and output negation. At a unanimous deterministic vertex with rare deviations e,u,v, the ratio is 2+O(delta ln(1/delta)); at a mixed vertex represented by probabilities (1-e,u,v), the ratio is 2+(2/ln2)(1+uv/[e(u+v)+uv])+O(delta ln(1/delta)), where delta=max(e,u,v) and each absolute error is at most 400 delta ln(1/delta) for delta<=1/8, with no restriction on relative rates. Codimension-two fixed-interior-r edge formulas are (12)-(13) of REPORT.md; their remainders are uniform only on compact r-subintervals. All deterministic boundary functions are contracted before zero-deficit division. No arbitrary-arity prime or universal FEI theorem is established.

exact_statement: For each of the eight essential binary Boolean sign gates with one exceptional truth-table corner, the supremum over all interior independent Bernoulli biases of corrected Hplus/(I-Var) is exactly 2+4/ln(2). For XOR and XNOR the supremum is exactly 2/ln(2). The suprema are not attained in the interior. Writing A(x)=x ln(1/x)/(1-x), corner ratios are 2+2[A(u)+A(v)]/ln(2), where u,v are probabilities of the exceptional corner coordinates; parity ratios are [A(1-4p(1-p))+A(1-4q(1-q))]/ln(2). These formulas extend as limits of interior ratios along arbitrary independent endpoint rates, while deterministic contracted functions have Hplus=I-Var=0. The common sharp corrected constant 2+4/ln(2) propagates through genuine read-once binary formulas under every product physical law by exact disjoint composition; on uniform physical inputs it implies ordinary H<= [2+4/ln(2)] I. No higher-arity prime or universal FEI estimate is established.
